message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts. Facts: In 1998, Pan sold a 160 sqm homestead land to Li for 7000. Then Li got land use certificate etc. In 2011, Pan sold same land again to Su (victim) using deception, got 30000. So victim discovered fraud, reported, Pan detained for fraud. He also had prior conviction for illegal acquisition of timber (but that is in probation period. The question: list crimes that this part of facts supports.

Crimes: Fraud (诈骗) under Chinese Criminal Law, specifically "诈骗罪". Also possibly "非法占有占领...". The double sale of same land constitutes fraud. Also "非法转让宅基地" maybe violation of land management law, but criminal? Under Chinese law, illegal transfer of rural homestead land may be "非法买卖宅基地" which is a crime under "非法买卖宅基地罪" (Article 338? Actually "非法买卖宅基地罪" in Criminal Law). The first sale to Li was legal? He sold his own land, presumably allowed? But selling homestead land is prohibited; rural homestead land cannot be transferred except within family. So the first sale may be illegal. However the facts only mention that he transferred to Li, and Li got land use certificate. That may be illegal sale of homestead land, which is a crime "非法买卖宅基地罪". Also the second sale is fraud, "诈骗罪". Also there is prior conviction for "非法收购盗伐、滥伐的林木罪" but that's not part of this fact. So we list: 诈骗罪;非法买卖宅基地罪.

Check Chinese law: Article 338 of Criminal Law: "非法买卖、出租、抵押、转让农村集体土地使用权或者宅基地的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处或者单处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So yes.

Thus answer: [罪名]诈骗;非法买卖宅基地<eoa>
